visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a red jacket and grey beanie stands on rocky terrain in Antarctica, looking towards a red wooden building. Small penguins waddle on the rocks nearby. The sky is overcast over snowy mountains. (2) Close-up shot of turquoise icebergs floating in dark blue water, followed by the woman smiling in a red hoodie on a boat deck. (3) A group of tourists in red parkas sit on a zodiac boat with a massive white cruise ship looming in the background. (4) The woman is inside a ship cabin, sitting by a window with a glass of white wine, watching the ocean waves pass by. (5) She appears on the ship's deck wearing a white furry coat and grey headband, holding a professional camera and looking at the snowy mountain range. (6) A sequence shows an airplane landing near mountains and water, then a view from an aircraft window overlooking mountain peaks and clouds. (7) A close-up of a web inquiry form for Antarctic cruises and a booking quote document from 'Silver Cloud Expedition' are shown. (8) The woman takes a mirror selfie in a white bathrobe in her cabin, then walks across a barren, rocky Antarctic field. (9) An informational table compares different ship types, followed by a montage of a sailboat, an icebreaker, and a large cruise ship at sea. (10) The woman waves from a pier near the 'Silver Cloud' ship, then interacts with penguins on a rocky shore. (11) Shots inside the ship show security staff, tourists on zodiacs, and the woman shouting excitedly to the camera. (12) Dining scenes follow: a server pours wine, a group toasts together, and a close-up of a plated breakfast dish. (13) The large ship sails through icy waters, concluding with a view of its wake at sunset.

(2) Subtle digital UI 'click' effects sound as text overlays appear. The narrator details the cost of her trip. (3) The tone remains friendly and informative as she mentions a specific travel agency. (4) A sharp rise in vocal arousal occurs as the narrator shouts excitedly about landing in Antarctica, mixed with a very faint outdoor noise floor. (5) A distinct percussive clink of glasses is heard, followed by multiple voices saying 'Cheers!'. (6) The narrator's speech rate increases as she enthusiastically describes the breakfast food, with her voice reaching a high-energy peak. (7) The upbeat BGM continues steadily with electronic drums and synths until it fades out along with the narrator's final words about the ship's stability in the Drake Passage.
